title: Chinnakuyil Paadum
lyrics:
Laa laa laalala … laa laa laalala

Chinna kuyil paadum paatu kekudhaa
Kukkoo kukkoo koo koo kukkoo kukkoo koo koo
Thambigalae thangaigalae theril ennai yetrungal
Ullaasamaai urchaagamaai oorai sutri kaatungal

Yengum manimelae thannandhaniyaa
Gangai nadhikenna kattuthariyaa
Ada vaanam yengu pogum angu naanum povenae
Yeppam vidum odaiyai ippodhudhaan paarkiren
Mainaakalin bhaasaiyai ippodhudhaan ketkiren
Brindhavanam ingae paarthenae la la la lalalaa

Aha indha boomi putham pudhusu
Paasam vandhadhaalae pongum manasu
Ini vaasam veesum poovil naanum vaasam seivenae
Thaavi yengum odinen thaayin madi thedinen
Poovanangal yengilum poojai seiya pogiren
En solaiyil naanum poovaven la la la lalalaa

title: Yamunai Aatrile
lyrics:
Yamunai aatrilae Eera kaatrilae
Kannanodu dhaan aada
Paarvai poothida Paadhai paarthida
Paavai raadhaiyo vaada

Iravum ponathu Pagalum ponathu
Mannan illayae kooda
Ilaiya kanniyin Imaithidaatha kan
Ingum angumae thaeda

Aayarpaadiyil kannan illaiyo
Aasai vaippathae anbu thollaiyo
Aayarpaadiyil kannan illaiyo
Aasai vaippathae anbu thollaiyo
Paavam raadhaa..

Yamunai aatrilae Eera kaatrilae
Kannanodu dhaan aada
Paarvai poothida Paadhai paarthida
Paavai raadhaiyo vaada

title: Ooru Sanam
lyrics:
Ooru sanam thoongiruchu oodha kaathum adichiruchchu
Paavi manam thoongalaiyae adhuvum ennoo puriyallaiyae

Kuyilu karunguyilu maaman manak kuyilu
Kolam podum paattaalae
Mayilu ila maayilu maaman kavi kuyilu
Raagam paadum kettaalae… sedhi sollum paattaalae

Onna enni naanae ullam vaadi ponen
Kanni ponnudhanae en maamanae… en maamanae

Othayilae athamaga onna nenachi rasicha maga
Kannu rendum moodallaiyae kaalam neram koodallaiyae

Maaman odhadu pattu naadham tharum kuzhalu
Naanaa maara koodaadha
Naalum thavamirundhu naanum ketta varam
Koodum kaalam vaaraadhaa… maaman kaadhil yeeraadha

Nelaakaayum neram nenjukulla baaram
Melum melum yerum indha nerandhaan…
Onna enni pottu vechen ola paaya pottu vechen
Ishta patta aasa machchaan enna melum yengha vechann

title: Inji Iduppazhagi
lyrics:
Inji iduppazhagi manja chevappazhagi
Kallach chirippazhagi marakka manam koodudhillaiye
Marakkuma maaman ennam? Mayakkudhe panjavarnam
Madiyile oonjal poda, maane vaa

Thannan thanichirukka, thathalichu thaanirukka
Un nenappil naan parichen, thaamaraiye
Punnai vanathinile, pedai kuyil koovaiyile
Unnudaiya vedhanaiyai nan arinjen
On kazhuthil maalaiyida, onnirandu tholai thoda
Enna thavam senjeno? En mamaa

Vannakkili kaiyaith thoda, chinna chinna kolamida
Ullam mattum un vazhiye, naane
Adikkira kathaik kaelu, asaiyura nathaik kaelu
Nadakkira athaik kaelu, nee thaana?

title: Kannan Vandhu
lyrics:
Kannan vandhu paadugindraan
Kaalamellam kannil enna kobam endraan
Geethangal sinthum kangal mooduthe
Paathangal vannap pankaL paaduthe
Mokangal ennum kannan thaerilae

Kaadhalennum koottukkulle aasai kuyil konjuthamm
IvaL vannang kodi... sinnam thaedi
Munnum thooLil kannam kooda santham paadi
Kaaman sonna kaaviyam thaano? Kaadhal konda oviyam thaano?

Vaanathil sellak kannan paaduvaan
Kaanathil chinnap pennum aaduvaaL
Aayarkal maththuch saththam polavae
Aanantha muththam sinthum neramae
Maalai nilaa... maalai nilaa pooththathamma
Mouna mozhi solluthamm

title: Sendhoora Poove
lyrics:
Sendhoora poove sendhoora poove
Jillenra kaatre
En mannan enge en mannan enge
Nee konjam sollaayo

Thendralai thoodhu vittu oru sethi ketaen
Kangalil neerai vittu naan kaathu nindraen
Vasantham varum neram en mannan varuvaana
Azhagu mugam kaati ennai aazhvaana

Kaatrinil pattam pole en manam thudikuthe
Kaadhalenum sithirathil uyir thudikuthe
Unnaiye ninaithu naan urugi nindraen
Ulagam maranthu naan tholaithu nindraen
Mannavan varum varai naanum kaathiruppen

title: Valaiyosai
lyrics:
Valaiyosai kala kala vena kavithaigal padikuthu
Kulu kulu thendral kaatrum veesuthu

Sila neram silu silu vena siru viral pada pada
Thudikuthu engum inbam pesuthu
Unakkena pirandhava naan, enakkena pirandhavan nee
Iruvarum oruvarai oruvar purinthu kondom

Andhi veyil neram thanga thidatilae
Alli konda kaadhal anbu thidatilae
Malarin vasam manathil pesuthae
Urugum neram unarvu kooruthae
Naan unnai serum naal entha naalo?

Vaanin meethu megam paadum paattu enna
Kaatril aadum poovum koorum sethi enna
Nenjil aasaigal pongiduthe, kannil minnalgal thondriduthe
Inba thene unnai thaane

title: Azhagu Malar Aada
lyrics:
Azhagu malar aada abinayangal kooda
Silambu oli koova sirippu oli thoova
Kanni manam thudikuthu, kaadhal isai padikuthu

Vaanin meethu megam paadum paattu enna
Kaatril aadum poovum koorum sethi enna
Nenjil aasaigal pongiduthe, kannil minnalgal thondriduthe
Inba thene unnai thaane

Maalai neram solai meethu thendral veesum pothu
Kaadhal geetham paadum nenjam mella thorum pothu
Aariraro paadidum annai anbu polavae
Unnai kanda pothu naanum unnil karaintheney

title: Thendral Vandhu
lyrics:
Thendral vandhu theendum pothu enna vannamo manasula
Thingal vandhu ulaavum pothu enna vannamo ninappula

Kangal aayiram thevaiya kaadhal kaviya paada
Kalaigal aayiram thevaiya kaadhal nadanam aada
Unnodu naan irunthaal ulagam enathagum
Ulagin mudivillum kaadhal thodarum

Vellai puraakal thaan kaadhal thoodhu sellume
Sollai maraithu thaan nenjam thavikkume
Unnai paarkum pothu naanum kavithei aagiren
Unnil karaiyum pothu naanum ennai marakkiren
Iravaai pagalai unaiye ninaikkiren

title: Kuyile Kavikuyile
lyrics:
Kuyile kavikuyile kuruvi ilam kuruvi
Kaalaiyil paadum paattu
Un isai ketaal nenjam uruguthe inbam konjam
Malarukku thene thene manasukku naane naane

Kaatrile un paattu kalandhu varuthe kettathum
Un paattil en nenjam mayangi vizhuthe paarthathum
Poonthalirilae vaasam veesum kulu kulu kaatre
Un kuralai ketaal ulagam thulli aadume
En manamum thulli thulli paadume

Kuyile kavikuyile kuruvi ilam kuruvi
Kaalaiyil paadum paattu

title: Munbe Vaa
lyrics:
Munbe vaa en anbe vaa Oone vaa uyire vaa
Munbe vaa en anbe vaa Poo poovaai pooppom vaa
Naan naanaa kaetten ennai naane
Naan neeyaa nenjam sonnathe

Rango rangoli kolangal nee poattaai
Koalam poattaval kaigal vaazhi
Valaiyal saththam jil jil jil
Rango rangoli kolangal nee poattaai
Koalam poattaval kaigal vaazhi
Sundara malligai santhana malligai
Sinthiya punnagai vannam minna

Poovukkul thaen irukkum varaiyil
Kaadhalar vaazhvagam poomiyil
Nee ninaikkum ninaivugal ellaam
En nenjinil kavitheyai maarum
Oru paarvaiyil kaadhalai sonnavanae
Oru vaarthaiyil uyirai thandhavanae
Unnodu naan irukkum ovvoru nodiyum
Ulagin mudivillai kaadhal thodarum

title: Vaseegara
lyrics:
Vaseegara en nenjinikka
Un pon madiyil thoonginaal poadhum
Adhey ganam en uyirum poanaal poadhum

Nenjathiley theeyai vaithu nindraal enna aagum
En aasaigal unthan paeril endrum vaazhum
Muzhu nilavaa unnai kandaen
En kangal irandum minna
Un nizhalil naan nadakka
En paatham irandum inikka

Nilaavin oliyena unnai kandaen
Kanaavin valiyena unnai kandaen
Iravilum pagalilum unnai ninaikkiren
Idhayathil unnai thaan sumaikiren
Un poygal kooda unmai thaan
Un kuralai ketaal sugam thaan
Ennai marandhu unnul karaintheney

title: Idhu Varai
lyrics:
Idhu varai illaadha uravidhu
Idhayathil undaana kanavidhu
Pazhagida ninaikkaiyil bayam varudhu

Paarthadhum paravasam aagudhu
Pesida thudikkudhu en manadhu
Unnaiye thaedudhu en kangal
Oru murai unnai paarthaal
Enakkulle yaedho aagudhu
Un sirippai kaetaal
Ulagamae azhagaagudhu

Intha ulagam puriyavillai
Intha kaadhal theriyavillai
Unnodu naanum nadakkaiyile
Kaalam karaiyum unarvillai
Nee vandhu poagum dhooram ellaam
Vaasam veesum poovalla
Nee nirkkum idathil en idhayam
Satham indri thudikkudhae

title: Pookal Pookum
lyrics:
Pookal pookum dharunam aaruyirae Paarthadhaarum illaiyae
Ularum kaalai pozhudhai mullaivanam Paarthadhum illaiyae
Indha mounam enna koorum Indha kaadhal enna seiyum
Idhayathai unnil tholaithaeney

Vaarthai illai mounamaai irukka
Vaazhkkai illai unnodu nadakka
Un kangalil ennai kandaen
En kavithaiyil unnai thandhaen
Oru nimidam unnai paarthaal
Oru yugamaai maarum anbe
Kaatril vandha vaasam poley
Nee vandhu poanaai nenjiley

title: Neeyum Naanum
lyrics:
Neeyum naanum anbe
Kangal korthu kondu
Vaazhvin ellai sendru Ondraai vaazhalaam

Oru paadhiyil naanum
Maru paadhiyil neeyum
Iruvarum inaindhaal
Ulagam azhagaagum

En kaadhal unnai naadum
En nenjam unnai thaedum
Un sirippil en ulagam thudikkum
Un paarvaiyil en iravu minnum
Intha payanam mudiyadhey
Un anbil naanum karaiyiren

title: Oru Dheivam
lyrics:
Oru dheivam thandha poove
Kannil theedhum illaiye
Ennai kaakum thaaye
Un paarvaiyil naane
Ennai marandhen thaaye

Sinnanjiru kiliye kannamma Selvakkalanchiyame
Un sirippai ketaal nenjam Urugum ponnamma

Iravilum pagalilum Un madiyil thaane
En urakkam vandhu Ennai thazhuvum thaane
Pillai kural ketaal Ulagam marandhu poagum
Anbu enum kadalil Ullam nanaindhu poagum

title: Kangal Edho
lyrics:
Kangal edho theda kalavaada
Nenjam thaanae paada parandhoda
Adi ovvoru raappozhudhum
Ona appadi naan rasichen
Uyir kolludhu onnenappu
Kanmaniye..oh

Oru aayiram vaanavilla Onpoovizhi kaattudahdi
Adha sattunnu nee marachaa Naan enna seiven pulla

Velayaattu pechula vesa oosi eathura
Nee lesaa paakka minnal kottiduthe
Oli paanja onmugam manasoda modhuthe
Nee pesum pechu aiyyo alliduthae

Ennennavo unkitta sollavaum thonudhadaa
Kaadhal vanthe sattunu sallada poduthadaa

title: Mallipoo
lyrics:
Mallipoo vechu vechu vaadudhu
Andha velli nila vandhu vandhu thedudhu
Machaan eppo vara poara?

En usuru thudikkudhu Unnai paarka ninaikkudhu
Kaalam ellaam un kooda Vaazha manam thavikkudhu

Pattu selai katti naan kaathu kidakkiren
En machaan varuvaan nu naan paathu kidakkiren
Thaali kattu raagam eppo keka poagudho?
Paavi nenjam eppo unnai katti kollumo?

title: Iravingu Theevai
lyrics:
Iravingu theevai namai chooluthe
Vidiyalum irulaai varuthe
Ninaivugal theeyai alai mothuthe
Udalingu saavai azhuthe

Pirive uruvai karainthu pogiren
Uyirin uyirai pirinthu pogiren
Malaigalin nadhipol manam vazhinthu vanthai
Varanthidum nilathil pala kadalgal thanthai

Kanave thunaiyai ozhinthu poghattum
Iravingu theevai namai chooluthe

Intha thamarai kulam meeri thani aaguthe
Athan sooriyan pagal indri veyil kaayuthe
Oru pathayil iru jeevan thunai theduthe
Ada kaalangal meeri thadai poduthe

Nee indri naane dhinam vazhvathoru vazhva
Vazhve vaa nee thaan uyirin uyire... varavaa

title: Kadhale Kadhale
lyrics:
Kaadhale kaadhale Thani perum thunaiye
Kaadhale kaadhale

Unnai paartha antha neram En manathil perum maattram
Kaadhal endra oru vaarthai Ennai aalum siru vaarthai

Nenjamellaam un ninaivu Kangalil un uruvu
Intha kaadhal endrum vaazhum Unnodu naan vaazhum varai

Vidiyum podhu unnai thedum Mudiyum podhu unnai paadum
Kaatril vandha geethamae Idhayam thudikkum naadhamae
